overview: A family feud sparks the rise of two legendary sneaker brands into a fierce global competition.
title: Sneaker Wars: Adidas v Puma
Jiu Ming! Wo Lao Gong Cha Xiang Si Yi
Snatched a Billionaire to Be My Husband

overview: In the Southeast Asian country of Nicara, Sheng Ze—the heir of the Chinese tycoon family conglomerate Shengye Group—returns for the funeral of his younger brother, Sheng An. Convinced that Sheng An was murdered by his personal maid, Qiao Wan, Sheng Ze vows to seize power and take revenge. Meanwhile, Shengye's current head, Sheng Huaijing, begins to test his nephew, who has returned shrouded in secrets. Was Qiao Wan acting under Sheng Huaijing's orders when she allegedly killed Sheng An? What was the true cause of Sheng An's death? Thus begins a ruthless power struggle within the wealthy Sheng family, rife with conspiracy and betrayal, entanglement and confrontation, secrets and desire. Which side will Qiao Wan ultimately choose, and will Sheng Ze succeed in taking control?
title: Gilded Bond

overview: George Clarke explores the extraordinary world of small builds, where people turn tiny spaces into the most incredible places to live, work and play. He even tries making a few of his own.
title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces

overview: A Los Golpes is a boxing sports talk show where David Faitelson, Bernardo Osuna and Julio Cesar Chavez discuss the most relevant in the world of boxing.
title: A Los Golpes

overview: During the Republic of China era, in the bustling and decadent district of Shili Yangchang, a pawnshop named Crimson hides in a quiet corner of the city. Whenever a woman suffers harm, the pawnshop opens its doors to deliver justice to those who wronged her. Led by owner Si Jiali and associates Lu Jingjin and others, the pawnshop team acts as vigilantes in the night. Committed to upholding factual justice, they dedicate themselves to helping women trapped in dire situations. Yet their actions draw the attention of Detective Zhou Mu of the city police. As the detective and vigilantes confront each other, the ideals of procedural justice clash with those of moral, real-world justice. Meanwhile, as Zhou Mu hunts the members of Crimson, a long-suppressed and shocking cold case slowly resurfaces—one that seems inextricably linked to everyone involved…
title: See the Light

overview: In 1994, three employees of the Yujiang Pharmaceutical Factory were brutally murdered on a typhoon night. Suspicion pointed directly to the factory's leadership—Xu Chengliang, Duan Zhigang, and Du Bin—but due to insufficient evidence, the case was shelved, becoming a lifelong regret for veteran detective Shi Guangming. Fifteen years later, Su Ran, a descendant of one of the victims, returns to Yujiang with her husband Zhao Lun under the guise of journalists. Exploiting a counterfeit-drug scandal at the pharmaceutical factory, they draw close to Xu Chengliang and the others, carefully setting the stage for revenge. Su Ran first exposes Du Bin's involvement in producing and selling fake drugs, only for Du Bin to be silenced soon after. She then provokes internal conflict by revealing an illicit affair between Duan Zhigang and Xu Chengliang's wife, leading to Duan's mysterious death. As a string of murders unfolds, Shi Guangming steps in to lead the investigation, and the situation rapidly escalates. Ultimately, through Su Ran's intricate schemes, the hidden villains meet brutal ends, none escaping their fate. Yet Su Ran herself cannot evade destiny or the law. Having fulfilled her long-awaited mission, she discovers that its end brings betrayal among allies, separation from loved ones, and the shattering realization that even the father she never doubted was nothing more than an illusion.
title: Gone Murderer

overview: The cold and domineering CEO, Cen Sen, and the arrogant young lady, Ji Ming Shu, go from mutual suspicion and manipulation to a life-and-death love. Throughout the process of changing their fate and saving each other, they experience a deep and passionate romance that begins with an arranged marriage.
title: My Queen, My Rules

overview: Series covering the infamous murder case, following the turbulent months after the conviction and a high-profile campaign to sway public opinion. For the first time, one affected family break their silence about their experience with Letby and their newborn.
title: Lucy Letby: Murder or Mistake

overview: Ellen Greenberg was found dead with 20 stab wounds. Philadelphia ruled it suicide. This three-part series follows her family's quest to find the truth.
title: Death in Apartment 603: What Happened to Ellen Greenberg?

overview: Cocaine Quarterback: Signal-Caller for the Cartel tells the unbelievable true tale of convicted drug trafficker Owen Hanson's rise from USC college football champion to smuggling for the world's most dangerous cartel.
title: Cocaine Quarterback: Signal-Caller for the Cartel

overview: Small Prophets is a comic tale of eccentric Michael Sleep who, since his darling Clea disappeared seven years ago, has lived a very ordinary life. He eats Shreddies, works in a DIY store, visits dad Brian and hopes for Clea to return. That is just the way it is, until one day dad Brian shares an old recipe involving rainwater, horse manure and more than a little alchemy. With recipe in hand, Michael sets out (albeit with some scepticism) to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future - in the hope they have the answer to his burning question, ‘will I ever see Clea again?'. Michael gets help from young work mate Kacey, an unlikely friendship that blossoms partly (but not wholly) through their mutual dislike of store manager Gordon. Their friendship adds to the frustration and intrigue of his nosy neighbours who are obsessed with trying to find out what the hell is going on in the garden shed.
title: Small Prophets
Shou Shen Nan Nu Zhi Zhong Liang Ji Lian Ai

overview: Tony Carpenter (Dennis Waterman) is a self-made millionaire and owner of a booming executive car hire business. He's made his way to the top but hasn't forgot his east-end roots, and much to his snooty wife's disgust, he treats his employees like friends. There's Mrs Wembley (Joan Sims) the cook, Sam (Sam Kelly) the chauffeur and of course his personal assistant Maggie (Jenna Russell), none of which he could live without. Follow this comical bunch of characters and Tony's troublesome daughter through trial and tribulations, in this entertaining sitcom about life when it's on the up!
title: On the Up

overview: In the winter of 1941, the Underground Communist Party, "Three Scenes of West Lake," is activated to counter the Imperial Japanese Army's biological warfare initiative, Project Slumber. Chen Kailai, an assistant photographer at Chunguang Photo Studio, sets off for Shanghai for a clandestine rendezvous after witnessing the death of his mentor, Li Musheng, an underground operative codenamed Broken Bridge. En route, he gets acquainted with Jinbao, a fugitive dance hostess sharing a similar plight. Aboard the train, they encounter Su Men, a special commissioner of the Wang-controlled puppet regime, and are drawn into the regime's infighting. Arriving in Shanghai, Chen opens a photo studio with Jinbao's assistance to await his contact—unaware that Jinbao is actually an agent, codenamed God of Wealth, under the nationalist military intelligence agency, NBIS. When Shen Kexi, codenamed Su Causeway, finally shows up, Chen hands over his late mentor's belongings to her and participates in underground operations. Witnessing Shen being arrested, Chen assists Zhao Qian, codenamed Leifeng Pagoda, to rescue her successfully. Determined to become a qualified underground agent, Chen takes over the codename Broken Bridge. Together with Su Causeway and Leifeng Pagoda, he carries out perilous tasks under the command of their superior codenamed Diana. Finally, Chen helps Shen sneak into the lab to steal samples, exposing the Japanese atrocities and preventing a viral disaster. However, along the way, Zhao, Shen, and Jinbao are martyred, and Chen records every moving moment with his camera.
title: Awaken

overview: This gripping four-part docuseries centers on the 2022 disappearance of 18-year-old Debanhi Escobar in Monterrey, Mexico.
title: Debanhi: ¿Quién mató a nuestra hija?

overview: Song U-Yeon (Park Ji-Hu) is an ordinary high school student, who isn't special in any specific thing. Her mother always put her older brother and younger brother before Song U-Yeon and her opinions are usually ignored at home. Due to this, Song U-Yeon doesn't express her feelings and she has low self-esteem. One day, a good looking man on the street asks her to pose as a model for a group of people. The man is Koo Sun-Ho (Choi Bo-Min) and the group are members of sketch club Spirit Fingers, including their President Nam Geu-Rin (Park Yoo-Na). Song U-Yeon poses on the street for them, but, unlike Song U-Yeon, the members are full of individuality and seem to get along well. This leads Song U-Yeon to join Spirit Fingers. The members encourage and compliment Song U-Yeon, which causes her self-esteem to grow. Meanwhile, Nam Gi-Jung (Jo Joon-Young) is Club President Nam Geu-Rin's younger brother and he is a high school student and the same age as Song U-Yeon. He has an attractive appearance and models for internet shopping malls as a part-time jpb. Due to Song U-Yeon, he begins to think about his future as a model seriously.
title: Spirit Fingers

overview: Asia Express is the Romanian version of the reality show Peking Express that was created in 2004.
title: Asia Express

overview: Biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill embarks on a groundbreaking mission to protect one of the world's most elusive creatures—the snow leopard. Set against the stunning backdrop of Kyrgyzstan's rugged mountains, this two-part adventure follows Dan as he works to build a new research center dedicated to studying these majestic cats.
title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill

overview: Dan, a philosopher, begins teaching a class of men in prison. Each week, Dan leads discussions about dominance, freedom, luck and other topics that have troubled philosophers for thousands of years – topics that gain a new meaning when seen through the prisoners' eyes - both igniting passions and creating tension. Through his work, Dan begins to dig deeper into his own past – growing up with a violent father who ended up in prison, as did his brother Lee and uncle Frank. Dan took a different path, but his time working in a prison begins to make him worry, obsessively, that he belongs behind bars just like his father. As Dan's personal crisis deepens, his actions begin to threaten both his own future, and his family's.
title: Waiting for the Out

overview: Professor Jim Al-Khalili unravels the mysteries of arguably the most complex object in the cosmos: the human brain.
title: Secrets of the Brain

overview: Butterflies was a British sitcom series broadcast on BBC2 from 10 November 1978 – 19 October 1983. The show starred Wendy Craig as frustrated 'stay at home' housewife, Ria Parkinson and Geoffrey Palmer as her reserved dentist husband, Ben.
title: Butterflies

overview: In a land where people are accustomed to battling fierce waves and constant storms, the story of a woman who stands tall on her feet, with all her emotional strength, resilience and endurance, and a man who is passionate about his "love" and who competes with the storms of the Black Sea and struggles with its waves, comes to the screens with an effective script... The ups and downs of the mountains, the sea and the human soul are told through the eyes of a stranger who finds himself in the middle of the endless war between two mortal enemies...
title: Taşacak Bu Deniz

title: Jesse & Joy: Lo que nunca dijimos
Wo Zai Zhe Li Deng Ni

overview: Taylor will dig deep across the Taylor Swift's 20-year career, a period that has seen her transcend the realm of pop star to become a cultural icon like no other. Through interviews with high-profile commentators, industry insiders and fans, the documentary examines the forces that have shaped her trajectory and the devoted community she has inspired. Rare archive will reveal fresh insights into Taylor and her story as the series charts her journey from ambitious teen with towering dreams to one of the most influential and scrutinised figures of our time.
title: Taylor

overview: Two young men, Zhao Shaoshang and Yuan Hong, come from vastly different educational and family backgrounds. Through one case after another, they learn from each other and grow together. In a sweeping era of change, they become the most brilliant crime-fighting duo.
title: Cases Between Us

overview: Walter Nebicher is a policeman. He is also an expert in computers. He developed a highly sophisticated hologram named Automan, which helps him fight crime. Automan has an assistant named Cursor that can create holographic objects such as a car, helicopter or any other object needed by Walter or Automan to fight crime.
title: Automan

overview: A shocking three-part docuseries centered on the discovery of child pornography tied to an international school in Karlstad, Sweden.
title: Tyst i klassen

overview: This is the ultimate search and rescue mission. Across 9 episodes, 10 everyday heroes battle time, extreme conditions, massive obstacles and each other to save a loved one.
title: Ultimate Escape

overview: Alan is trying to find the answers to who he was in the past and who he is now, every time he looks in the mirror, an old man appears. One day he meets Darwin, a young man who seems to be in the room next to Alan's in the mental health hospital. He's liked Alan since their first meeting.
title: Mystique in the Mirror

overview: The world is full of creative professions. The podcast is dedicated to representatives of these specialties, including artists of all kinds, from screen stars to stand-up comedians. In each episode, the host meets a person who has something to share about their work and life.
title: В поиске себя

overview: Art critic Waldemar Januszczak explores three of art's most controversial and important subjects.
title: Art's Most...

overview: Each episode of the film is a flight, a meeting with new passengers, and therefore new destinies, new "life" stories, new problems that will be resolved before our eyes, right on the train...
title: Рельсы счастья

overview: Hosted by broadcaster and self-confessed superfan, Greg James, each episode will premiere on More4 directly after the weekly broadcast of Grand Designs on Channel 4. Each week, Greg James will sit down with Grand Designs host, Kevin McCloud to ask the questions viewers most want answered. Together, they'll reflect on the episode and take a deeper look at the build, with an informal and engaging exchange that brings out the detail and decision-making behind each project.
title: Grand Designs: Deconstructed

overview: This is Your Life was created by Ralph Edwards, an American radio and television host. The show originated on radio, debuting in 1948, successfully transferring to NBC television in October 1952. The British version of the show was launched in 1955 by BBC television, and was initially broadcast monthly, then fortnightly, before becoming a regular weekly fixture in the TV schedules by its third series. The BBC produced the show's first nine series before axing the programme in 1964. The London based Thames Television revived the show in 1969 and broadcast weekly editions over the ITV network, producing an average of 26 shows a year. ITV continued broadcasting the show right through to 1994 despite a change of presenter when Michael Aspel took over after the death of original host Eamonn Andrews in 1987. This is Your Life returned to the BBC in 1994, but was still produced independently by Thames Television, and was axed again in 2003. In the show the host surprises a special guest, before taking them through their life with the assistance of the 'big red book'.
title: This is Your Life

overview: George Clarke's Homes in the Wild follows George as he embarks upon an epic journey to some of the hundreds of islands dotted around New Zealand's coastline and Australia's eastern seaboard on a quest to explore some of the countries' wildest homes. While meeting an array of colourful characters and navigating rugged terrain, George will discover just what it takes to reside and thrive in an offshore island home.
title: George Clarke's Homes in the Wild

overview: Set within the crumbling walls of The Argyle, a venerable iconic theatre company on the brink of bankruptcy, Bad Company follows Margie, the Argyle's volatile artistic director, whose unchecked whims have sent the company spiraling, and Julia a high-flying corporate executive brought in to clean up Margie's mess.
title: Bad Company

overview: A new outlook on a foreign group, whose culture and traditions are being threatened by the modern world.
title: Rendez-vous en terre inconnue

overview: A huge jellyfish-like object is seen over Stockholm and triggers global panic. Biologist Zandra Kraft realizes that it may be humanity's first contact with intelligent extraterrestrial life. Together with Prime Minister Moa Halmgren and crisis expert Elias Charbel, she must deal with hysteria, corruption and the threat of military intervention. In the roles we see Evin Ahmad, Fares Fares and Suzanne Reuter and others.
title: Vi kommer i fred

overview: When killers think they've gotten away, the real game begins. 50 Cent hosts the ultimate true-crime series - where clever detectives outsmart ruthless killers, and justice comes with a twist.
title: 50 Ways to Catch a Killer

overview: A lawyer, a liar, a family consumed by the thirst for power... In this story where everyone hides their own truth, there is only one question: Who is the biggest fraud?
title: Sahtekarlar

overview: Adolfo Suárez remained seated as coup plotters' bullets flew around him in Congress on February 23, 1981, while all MPs except Gutierrez Mellado and Carrillo hid under their seats.
title: Anatomía de un instante

overview: Salvage Dawgs is a trip into a world of shrewd negotiations as Robert Kulp and Mike Whiteside — co-owners of one of the premier architectural salvage operations in the United States, Black Dog Salvage — bid on homes and buildings condemned to be demolished. Their goal is to secure the remarkable pieces of America's past hidden inside these old structures before they are lost forever. These salvaged vintage pieces include everything from doors, windows, mantels and more. Once they are recovered, the guys sell these valuable pieces to a wide range of clients, from construction workers to high-end interior designers, who use them to restore other historical buildings and add character to newer structures.
title: Salvage Dawgs

overview: Crazy Quilt is the tale of a quilt that takes viewers along for a learning adventure and craft creations in every episode. The hosts Maggie and Jackson teach kids to make crafts.
title: Crazy Quilt

overview: Treetown is the home of the playful Treetownies. Tansy, Rosabelle, and the Treetown toys invite viewers to play, sing, explore, and imagine with them.
title: Treetown

overview: A Canadian First Nations family learns lessons and stories from their elderly grandfather and the animals around them, shared in the form of animated puppetry.
title: Tipi Tales

overview: In Adana, the feud between the Bereketoğulları and Karahanlıs families reignites. As Ömer Bereketoğul struggles to protect his family and land, newly appointed prosecutor Nevin arrives, seeking justice for her fiancé's death. Their collision sparks a dangerous bond, where duty and desire clash and love becomes the most unpredictable weapon of all.
title: Bereketli Topraklar

overview: He doesn't remember his name, who he is or where he came from, but one day he woke up in the hospital with multiple injuries and no memory. Now he is forced to wander around the city, sleep where he has to, and eat what he is given, but at the same time he has not lost his human appearance and dignity, as much as possible under the circumstances. The children called him Compote because of his special love for the drink from their school cafeteria, where he is fed by a compassionate cook. A group of high school friends decides to help Compote, find out the truth and try to bring back his real life, but "completing this quest and finding the key" turns out to be quite difficult.…
title: Камбэк

overview: In Hawaii, the word "ohana" means family and for this bold, vibrant and tight-knit group of friends, they love and argue just like family. These young Hawaiian locals are stepping out of their parents' expectations and carving their own paths while still embracing their culture. As they navigate love, face heartbreak and test friendship loyalties, this group proves life on the island has just as much shade as there is sun.
title: O'ahu Shores
Du Xin Lao Gong You Dian Tian

overview: Street Hawk is an all-terrain attack motorcycle, designed to fight urban crime. It is capable of speeds up to 300 mph and has immense firepower. Jesse Mach (Rex Smith, As the World Turns), an ex-motorcycle cop, is recruited to uphold justice driving a powerful motorcycle named Street Hawk. This show was originally going to start in the fall of 1984, but ABC shelved it with a summer hit, Call to Glory.
title: Street Hawk

overview: After an unjust death at the hands of the tyrannical Emperor Jun Che, Lu Yingying, the daughter of a disgraced Minister of Rites, is miraculously reborn before the tragedies unfold. Vowing to change her destiny, she seeks out Jun Che when he is still a convict and buys him, becoming his master...
title: The Tower of Whispers

overview: In the 14th year of Tang Tianbao, the An Shi Rebellion broke out. The emperor fled west, leaving the eunuch Chen Jingbian in sole control of Chang'an. Possessing the Night Firefly Map, which holds the secrets of the realm's most powerful figures after their deaths, Chen becomes the target of spies from all directions. At this critical moment, Feng Yinniang, the daughter of a military family, ventures alone into Chang'an. Disguised as a healer, she approaches Chen Jingbian, seeking to seize the Night Firefly Map and uncover the mastermind behind the conspiracy that destroyed her family.
title: Rescued The Lost Times

overview: It's 1987, and Detective Georgia Cooke is called in to investigate the massacre of four scientists who have been brutally murdered in inexplicable ways, with a lone survivor the obvious suspect. But as Georgia digs deeper, unravelling a complex case entangled in mania, ritual, and the occult, her obsessive quest for the truth spirals into a nightmare that will put her family, career, and sanity on the line. 37 years later, a chilling new spree of murders will pull Georgia back into this nightmare as she confronts the terrifying possibility that the horrors at Parrish Station were never fully buried.
title: The Killings at Parrish Station

overview: In 1899, Céleste, a can-can dancer in a Montmartre cabaret, desperately tries to find the brother and sister from whom she was brutally separated as a child when their father was murdered before their eyes. To pay Léon, the inspector tasked with finding them, she has no choice but to become Paris's first stripper. Arsène, a young automobile engineer from the wealthy neighborhoods, is preparing to take over the reins of his father's factory. Engaged, he cannot bring himself to marry even though he secretly loves men. He then takes the risk of opposing his father and suddenly breaks off his engagement. Rose, a young laundress from the suburbs, deeply in love, is preparing to start a family with her fiancé. But her dream is short-lived when he actually leads her to a brothel where she is locked up. Rose manages to escape, but pursued by her pimps, she throws herself into the Marne and finds herself between life and death. None of our three heroes realizes that blood ties connect them.
title: Montmartre

overview: This legal comedy showcases Keith's winning performance as a high-flying, no-nonsense barrister who rarely loses a case and certainly doesn't suffer fools gladly! Philippa Troy's cases always involve an element of the absurd (if not the downright bizarre), and her clients include an irate football fan sporting a wonky tattoo, and a shipwrecked yachtsman accused of eating his companion! Her professional colleagues are, if anything, even worse: Philippa's principal court adversary is a Bible-thumping bigot, while her instructing solicitor is a keen hypochondriac who insists on regaling her with all the graphic details of his latest ailments. When it all gets too much for her, though, she can at least withdraw into the fantasy world of Prickly Peter...
title: Law and Disorder

overview: Singapore Changi Airport is world-renowned for its passenger terminals, but how many people know it's also one of the busiest air cargo hubs in the world as it processes over 1.5 million tonnes of goods? From horses and ornamental fish to fresh cherries and flowers, Premium Rush: Inside Air Cargo Singapore gives you exclusive access into the hidden world of Changi Airport's airfreight operations, as we follow some amazing journeys.
title: Premium Rush: Inside Air Cargo Singapore

overview: At Camp Aweegaway, a Christian summer camp filled with adventure and camaraderie, kids come together for experiences that challenge and inspire them. Between team-building competitions, campfires, and heartfelt conversations, they form deep friendships and uncover new layers of their faith and identity. Each day at camp offers opportunities for growth, connection, and unforgettable memories.
title: A Week Away: The Series

overview: A three episodes documentary about the most decorated war hero in Norway, the young Gunnar "Kjakan" Sønsteby (Code named "No. 24") and his life as an undercover agent during the second world war. We follow the story in his own words, telling about his upbringing in the town of Rjukan where he and a lot of his fellow class mates become some of the second World wars most important saboteurs and resistance men against the German war machine. We follow his work as a cob web spinner during the war in Oslo, while being a student, until the successful end of the war as one of the most trusted by the Norwegian government.
title: Rapport fra Nr. 24

overview: Inspector Antonio George smells foul play in the mysterious death of Samuel Umman. As his investigation leads him to Samuel's employee, Francis, Antonio realizes that a much larger game is in play.
title: Kammattam

overview: The five protagonists, one among them being a dwarf hailing from a slum, as they venture into the flower mafia around temples and other odd businesses to gain the respect of the public.
title: The Chronicles of the 4.5 Gang

overview: Executive Stress is a British sitcom that aired on ITV from October 20, 1986 - December 27, 1988. It stars Penelope Keith as Caroline Fairchild, a middle-aged woman who decides to go back to work. Her husband, Donald, is played by Geoffrey Palmer in the first series. Palmer was unable to return for the second series, so Peter Bowles played Donald in the remaining two series.
title: Executive Stress

overview: The four-part limited series follows mother-daughter team Debbie Dykstra and Sarah Dykstra as they take on the ambitious challenge of building a home based on the last set of plans created by legendary architect Frank Lloyd Wright before his death in 1959. Executive produced by Chip and Joanna Gaines, The Last Wright offers an unprecedented look at the intersection of timeless design and modern construction.
title: The Last Wright: Building the Final Home Design of America's Greatest Architect

overview: Know it all nina is a popular web series on dream works tv on YouTube, Jenna Ortega plays lead role of Nina that thinks she knows everything people are free to tweet questions that Nina will answer but at the end they out smart her.
title: Know It All Nina

overview: At a middle school in Pisa, no one has ever challenged the cool kids — until new girl Terry arrives with bold ideas and the rivalries begin.
title: RIV4LI

overview: Four close-knit friends in their 40s do their best to face a new world of modern masculinity — but even their best tends to make things worse.
title: Alphamännchen

overview: A career-driven game developer fights back against misogynistic expectations after she becomes the target of brutal attacks online and in real life.
title: The Game: You Never Play Alone

overview: Comedy icon Penelope Keith stars as Jean Price, a newly elected Labour MP who finds her cherished principles severely tested in the unforgiving, often murky world of Westminster. Jean's ambition withstands the dreadful facilities and uncivilised hours that might drive a lesser woman out of the job, with the wife and mother managing to hold her own amid the swollen egos, rampant chauvinism and Machiavellian scheming of the political elite; husband Geoff provides much-needed moral support. Also featuring Ruth Rendell Mysteries star George Baker as Tory adversary Sir Godfrey Eagan and Garfield Morgan as Labour whip Norman, this cleverly scripted Thames comedy was directed by BAFTA Award winner John Howard Davies, whose high-profile credits include The Good Life, Fawlty Towers and Mr. Bean. Made by Thames Television for the ITV Network.
title: No Job for a Lady

overview: In 2013, young Lyosha almost achieved what he had dreamed of since childhood.: his cryptocurrency trading startup is about to open the doors to China for him. However, fate abruptly changes course. The whole family suddenly moves to a small town in the Far East — Lyosha's father, Mikhail, expects to start a new business there. The plans are ruined when the shocking truth is revealed: Mikhail has huge debts, and bandits are on the trail of the family. When it seems that there is no way out, Mikhail learns about his son's technological development and decides to use it to earn money. So, risking everything, the father and son begin to transfer huge sums of money into cash for criminal structures. Their lives are turning into a dangerous game where freedom is at stake, and the stakes are getting higher every day.
title: Обнальщик
